witness_probes.basis: Orel 2003:211 *katilaz (Lat. catillus loan; OE cytel); R/T 2014 p. 272 ('apparently not of cytel, cetel'); Luick §336 / Brunner §159c: deletion only in open medial syllables — nom. sg. *katilaz has *i in a closed final syllable after apocope and is outside every published formulation of the change

Lat. angelus loan; OE engel, gen. engles (Campbell §574). Latent heavy-closed overgeneration probe: the selected-cell architecture sees post-apocope strings, so neither the current rule nor the reformulation can distinguish *spinnil (historically trisyllabic *spinnilō, syncopated while open) from a nominative that was never trisyllabic. Recorded as a latent out-of-corpus limitation, equal in all variants.
